HF_duplicate: auxiliary HF is charged separately and is not a fitting row

acquisition.analytic_source: authenticated training-only Section5 HF coupling/gap screening; no correlated reference or held-out input
acquisition.diagnostic_reservation: metadata-only independent seeded128unique circuits per geometry, before the first HF request
acquisition.fallback: first1024 per geometry only if actual quota or predeclared schedule prevents full completeness, all3 have1024 and quality passes; never quality-failure rescue
acquisition.full_release: first2048 eligible rows per geometry in acquisition order; stop on completeness, leave unused quota unused
acquisition.guided_angle_recipe: global uniform[0.5,1.5] times per-gate choice[0.75,1,1.25] times -2*whole_qubit_HF_derivative/gap; nearest existing angle, lowest index ties; shuffle order
acquisition.guided_template_selection: mandatory all-wire cover; half remaining slots highest analytic score, rest square-root-score weighted sampling without replacement
acquisition.local_mutations: uniform1..3 edits; each edit angle-neighbor50%, replacement-ID25%, swap-positions25%
acquisition.local_parent: uniformly choose among best32 retained fitting rows by energy, circuit tuple, row_id
acquisition.local_without_parent: guided proposal with explicit fallback metadata; still charged
acquisition.novelty: exact complete ID tuple within one geometry; no energy-ranked row filtering

quality_policy.correlation_limit: string diversity and ESS do not count independent molecular observations or certify model generalization
quality_policy.failure: retain negative evidence and stop before fitting; no energy-ranked subset, seed replacement or silent threshold amendment
quality_policy.scope: balanced released acquisition-order fitting prefix only
quality_policy.weight_concentration_origin: old study5percent engineering safeguard; not a validated LLM sample requirement
quality_policy.weight_statistics: corpus.geometry_weights on fitting rows only, exact fixed lambdas, no automatic lambda choice

acquisition.request_order: three HF requests, all384 pre-reserved diagnostics, then balanced geometry-round-robin fitting
acquisition.reservation_collision_policy: fail before any physical request; never silently replace a reservation
acquisition.scoring_source: fresh corpus requests only; no historical or pilot labels copied
acquisition.uniform: independent exact uniform IDs0..512 including identity at each position

final_label_integrity: first,middle,last selected fitting row plus first diagnostic at each geometry
request_logging: fsynced intent then fsynced response; every intent charged including failure or crash
resume: new immutable journal segment; pending intents abandoned and charged; no silent energy replay
row_retention: all eligible novel fitting rows, including poor and rejected local proposals
